ideas.pitch: An AI-powered municipal feedback aggregator that parses local Ottawa public consultation transcripts and maps citizen sentiment to city council agenda items.
ideas.title: OttawaCivicPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting local government data appeals strongly to judges looking for tangible regional impact in Ottawa without needing corporate sponsor integrations.

ideas.pitch: Predictive modeling platform for OC Transpo bus delays and pedestrian hazards during Ottawa winter storms using historical weather feeds and crowd-sourced reports.
ideas.title: WinterTransitRisk
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leveraging local utility pain points like Ottawa winters instantly resonates with local judges and event organizers.

ideas.pitch: Automated pipeline for tracking federal legislative changes and lobbying disclosures, synthesizing complex policy documents into digestible impact briefs for journalists.
ideas.title: ParliamentWatch
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps into the political ecosystem of Ottawa by providing practical value for federal policy watchers.

ideas.pitch: Satellite imagery analytics platform monitoring urban tree canopy health and green space loss in the National Capital Region.
ideas.title: CapitalCanopy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard geospatial engineering with environmental monitoring, mimicking proven high-scoring technical architectures.

ideas.pitch: Supply chain transparency ledger designed for local Ontario agricultural producers to track carbon offset metrics from farm to Ottawa farmers' markets.
ideas.title: BioRegionTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on regional sustainability initiatives, aligning with themes commonly favored by academic and community-backed hackathon judges.
